# Inventory

> Deep inventory: unique item instances, stacks and equip slots.

- Package: `Inventory` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Inventory")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Inventory`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/InventoryService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Inventory = GaxiaServer.Inventory
```

### Functions

- `Inventory.DefineItem(itemId: string, def: ItemDef): ()`
- `Inventory.Add(player: Player, itemId: string, opts: AddOpts?): string`
- `Inventory.Remove(player: Player, instanceId: string, count: number?): boolean`
- `Inventory.Get(player: Player, instanceId: string): Instance_?`
- `Inventory.List(player: Player): { Instance_ }`
- `Inventory.GetByItemId(player: Player, itemId: string): { Instance_ }`
- `Inventory.Equip(player: Player, instanceId: string, slot: string?): (boolean, string)`
- `Inventory.Unequip(player: Player, slot: string): boolean`
- `Inventory.GetEquipped(player: Player, slot: string): Instance_?`
- `Inventory.IsEquipped(player: Player, instanceId: string): boolean`
- `Inventory.GetEquipment(player: Player): { [string]: string }`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Inventory.OnAdd` — `Signal<Player, Instance_>`
  (player, instance) after Add minted an instance or grew a stack (the stored instance)
- `Inventory.OnRemove` — `Signal<Player, string, string>`
  (player, instanceId, itemId) after Remove deleted a whole instance (not on a partial stack decrement)
- `Inventory.OnEquip` — `Signal<Player, string, string?>`
  (player, slot, instanceId) after an equip change; instanceId nil = the slot was emptied

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type ItemDef = { Stackable: boolean?, MaxStack: number?, EquipSlot: string? }
export type Instance_ = { id: string, itemId: string, count: number, props: any }
export type AddOpts = { Count: number?, Props: any? }
```
